levels.name: Harp Span
levels.teaches: Steel is tough: legs on two storeys, one blast
levels.tip:
Steel is tough.
Two storeys, one blast.
levels.ftip: Steel: hit its legs on two storeys, one blast.

levels.name: Stripey Light
levels.tip:
Tip it down the row.
Stack on steel.
levels.ftip: Two TNT per steel leg.

levels.name: The Sail
levels.tip:
Open the hall.
Then stack on steel.
levels.ftip: Hall first. Then the steel legs.

levels.name: Dome Hall
levels.tip:
HARD. All fall away
from the hospital.
levels.ftip: Outer side of each. The hall: its whole back.

levels.name: The Pedestal
levels.teaches: Dark piers: one TNT on each
levels.tip:
Dark piers:
TNT on each one.
levels.ftip: One TNT on every dark pier.

levels.name: The Doorstop
levels.tip:
Look behind it.
Dark piers: TNT on each.
levels.ftip: Keep two TNT for the core.

levels.name: Cube Grove
levels.tip:
One pole, one TNT.
Steel: stack.
levels.ftip: TNT right on each pole.

levels.name: Big Bow
levels.tip:
BOSS! Each pylon
has one way down.
levels.ftip: Both fall outward: the whole outer row.

levels.name: The Stepper
levels.teaches: Keep the road clear: fall into the yard
levels.tip: Keep the road clear.
levels.ftip: Blast the back. Fall into the yard.

levels.name: The Pencil
levels.tip:
Road in front.
Blast every back.
levels.ftip: Turn the view. Blast the backs.

levels.name: Tube Bundle
levels.tip:
Tip it down the row,
away from the road.
levels.ftip: Blast its back. The row follows.

levels.name: Deco Needle
levels.tip:
HARD. Only one way
is open.
levels.ftip: Blast the whole back row.

levels.name: Glass Point
levels.teaches: Glass holds nothing: hit the dark frame
levels.tip:
Glass holds nothing.
Hit the dark frame.
levels.ftip: TNT on the four dark piers.

levels.name: The Bullet
levels.tip:
Steel behind glass:
stack on it.
levels.ftip: Two TNT on each steel leg.

levels.name: The Splinter
levels.tip:
Tip the glass tower
down the row.
levels.ftip: Hit its frame on the row side.

levels.name: Sister Spires
levels.tip:
HARD. One way down
for each spire.
levels.ftip: Left spire left. The others back.

levels.name: Old Tock Row
levels.tip:
One push.
The whole row goes.
levels.ftip: Tip the clock tower right.

levels.name: Sky Steps
levels.tip:
BOSS! Road, school,
glass, steel.
levels.ftip: Tower back. Mast back: stack.

levels.name: Stack Tower
levels.tip:
Dark piers: one each.
Steel: stack.
levels.ftip: One TNT on each dark pier.

levels.name: Sky Saucer
levels.teaches: One TNT by the barrels: they blast for free
levels.tip:
Barrels blast
for free.
levels.ftip: One TNT next to the barrels.

levels.name: Rivet Depot
levels.tip:
Barrels show
the way down.
levels.ftip: TNT by the barrels. Then the rest.

levels.name: Tock Yard
levels.tip: Row, then barrels.
levels.ftip: Tip the clock tower at the barrels.

levels.name: Dome Works
levels.tip:
HARD. Some barrels
are a trap.
levels.ftip: Outer sides only. Mind the barrels.

levels.name: Sail Lot
levels.teaches: Find the gap between the blue buildings
levels.tip: Drop it in the lot.
levels.ftip: Blast the back: land on the yellow lot.
